subject: a tall stack of three thick, hearty oatmeal pancakes with visible rolled oats in the batter, topped with a dollop of Greek yogurt, fanned banana slices, a drizzle of honey, chopped walnuts, a few blueberries and a pinch of toasted oats
hero_ko: 오트 반죽(알갱이 질감) + 바나나 슬라이스 + 그릭요거트 + 꿀 + 다진 호두 + 오트 뿌림

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The batter is made with rolled oats, so the pancakes are not smooth: the side wall of each one is a warm oat-cream crumb (#E6CFA3) with a coarser, rustic texture in which flattened oat flakes (#D7C7A3) lie flush with the surface, plainly visible as pale ovals of different sizes among the air pockets; the top face is griddle-browned in a soft blotchy gradient — nutty golden-brown (#B07A42) at the centre fading to warm tan (#D3A66C) at the rim — with the outlines of a few oat flakes showing through the browning as paler flecks and a slightly rougher, more textured surface than a plain pancake. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: GREEK YOGURT
toppings.text: One generous dollop of thick Greek yogurt (#FBF6EC), spooned rather than piped, sits slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake: a dense, matte, softly peaked mound with a spoon-mark on one side, its lower edge settling into a soft skirt against the warm pancake.

toppings.label: BANANA
toppings.text: Four slices of banana about 7 mm thick, cut a little unevenly, fanned in an overlapping row that leans against the yogurt — pale creamy yellow (#F1E3A6) flesh with the small dark seed-dots in the centre, thin golden skins-edges (#D9B85A) just turning brown at one or two rims, one slice tipped slightly forward showing its edge, a faint moist sheen on the cut faces.

toppings.label: HONEY, NUTS AND OATS
toppings.text: A thin drizzle of clear golden honey (#D9A441), translucent and glossy, traced in one loose zigzag over the yogurt and banana and spilling over the front edge into two slow drips of different lengths down the side walls. A small handful of toasted walnuts (#A9784A), coarsely chopped into pieces of clearly different sizes with their ridged surfaces showing, sprinkled over the yogurt and the banana. About a dozen toasted rolled oat flakes (#C9A46E) pinched over the top of the yogurt, a few sliding down its side.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: Five blueberries (#3E4A73) with a dusty grey-blue bloom, each a slightly different size, tucked in a loose cluster between the yogurt and the banana, one alone near the rim. A very light dusting of ground cinnamon over the near rim. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. Appetizing food-photography color grading: warm, fresh, clean whites, saturated but natural colours, no colour cast on the background. Shot as if with an 85 mm lens at a comfortable distance, everything in crisp focus.
